controls.name: Real-time protection
controls.description: Configures whether Microsoft Defender Antivirus real-time protection is enabled.

parameters.label: Enabled
parameters.description: Whether Microsoft Defender Antivirus real-time protection is enabled.

controls.name: Scheduled scan type
controls.description: Configures the type of scheduled Microsoft Defender Antivirus scan.

parameters.label: Scan type
parameters.description: Type of scheduled Microsoft Defender Antivirus scan.

controls.name: Block read access to removable disks
controls.description: Configures the computer-scoped Windows machine policy for removable-disk read access according to the selected access state.

parameters.label: Access
parameters.description: Desired machine-policy state for removable-disk read access.

controls.name: Domain firewall profile
controls.description: Configures whether the Domain Windows Defender Firewall profile is enabled.

parameters.label: Enabled
parameters.description: Whether the Domain firewall profile is enabled.

controls.name: Account lockout threshold
controls.description: Configures the local security policy that locks a local account after the selected number of failed sign-in attempts.

parameters.label: Failed attempts
parameters.description: Failed sign-in attempts before a local account is locked.

relationships.description: When lockout threshold is selected, the same Policy selection must also include lockout duration and reset-counter-after, and duration must be greater than or equal to reset-counter-after.

controls.name: Minimum password length
controls.description: Configures the local security policy that requires a minimum password length for local accounts.

parameters.label: Minimum length
parameters.description: Required minimum number of characters for local account passwords.

controls.name: Require Ctrl+Alt+Delete
controls.description: Configures the computer-scoped Windows machine policy that requires the secure attention sequence before interactive sign-in.

policy.groupPolicyName: Interactive logon: Do not require CTRL+ALT+DEL

controls.name: Advertising ID
controls.description: Configures the computer-scoped Windows machine policy that allows or blocks application use of the Windows advertising identifier.

parameters.label: Allowed
parameters.description: Whether applications may use the Windows advertising identifier for cross-app experiences.

controls.name: Remote Desktop availability
controls.description: Configures whether the endpoint allows incoming Remote Desktop connections.

parameters.label: Enabled
parameters.description: Whether incoming Remote Desktop connections are allowed.

controls.name: Require SMB client signing
controls.description: Configures whether the SMB client requires security signatures for outbound SMB connections.

parameters.label: Enabled
parameters.description: Whether the SMB client requires security signatures for outbound SMB connections.

controls.name: Behavior monitoring
controls.description: Configures whether Microsoft Defender Antivirus behavior monitoring is enabled.

parameters.label: Enabled
parameters.description: Whether Microsoft Defender Antivirus behavior monitoring is enabled.

controls.name: Scheduled scan day
controls.description: Configures the scheduled Microsoft Defender Antivirus scan day.

parameters.label: Scheduled day
parameters.description: Day on which Microsoft Defender Antivirus runs its scheduled scan.

controls.name: Block write access to removable disks
controls.description: Configures the computer-scoped Windows machine policy for removable-disk write access according to the selected access state.

parameters.label: Access
parameters.description: Desired machine-policy state for removable-disk write access.

controls.name: Private firewall profile
controls.description: Configures whether the Private Windows Defender Firewall profile is enabled.

parameters.label: Enabled
parameters.description: Whether the Private firewall profile is enabled.

controls.name: Account lockout duration
controls.description: Configures the local security policy that determines how many minutes a locked local account remains unavailable.

parameters.label: Duration
parameters.description: Minutes before a locked local account is automatically unlocked.

controls.name: Maximum password age
controls.description: Configures the local security policy that determines how many days a local account password may be used before it expires.

parameters.label: Maximum age
parameters.description: Days before a local account password expires. Set 0 for never expires.

relationships.description: When maximum and minimum password age are selected together, minimum password age must be less than maximum password age unless maximum password age is set to never expire.

controls.name: Hide last signed-in user
controls.description: Configures the computer-scoped Windows machine policy that hides the most recently signed-in identity on the sign-in screen.

policy.groupPolicyName: Interactive logon: Don't display last signed-in

controls.name: Location access
controls.description: Configures the computer-scoped Windows machine policy that controls whether Windows apps may access device location.

parameters.label: Access mode
parameters.description: Desired default location-access policy for Windows apps on the device.

controls.name: Require Network Level Authentication
controls.description: Configures whether Remote Desktop requires Network Level Authentication for remote connections.

parameters.label: Enabled
parameters.description: Whether Remote Desktop requires Network Level Authentication.

controls.name: Require SMB server signing
controls.description: Configures whether the SMB server component requires security signatures for inbound SMB connections.

parameters.label: Enabled
parameters.description: Whether the SMB server component requires security signatures for inbound SMB connections.

controls.name: Cloud-delivered protection
controls.description: Configures whether Microsoft Defender Antivirus cloud-delivered protection is enabled.

parameters.label: Enabled
parameters.description: Whether Microsoft Defender Antivirus cloud-delivered protection is enabled.

controls.name: Scheduled scan time
controls.description: Configures the local time at which Microsoft Defender Antivirus runs its scheduled scan.

parameters.label: Scheduled time
parameters.description: Local time at which Microsoft Defender Antivirus runs its scheduled scan.

controls.name: Block execution from removable disks
controls.description: Configures the computer-scoped Windows machine policy for removable-disk execute access according to the selected access state.

parameters.label: Access
parameters.description: Desired machine-policy state for removable-disk execute access.

controls.name: Public firewall profile
controls.description: Configures whether the Public Windows Defender Firewall profile is enabled.

parameters.label: Enabled
parameters.description: Whether the Public firewall profile is enabled.

controls.name: Reset account lockout counter after
controls.description: Configures the local security policy that determines how many minutes must pass before failed sign-in attempts are forgotten.

parameters.label: Reset counter after
parameters.description: Minutes before failed local account sign-in attempts are forgotten.

controls.name: Minimum password age
controls.description: Configures the local security policy that prevents local account passwords from being changed again before the selected number of days has elapsed.

parameters.label: Minimum age
parameters.description: Days before a local account password may be changed again.

controls.name: Machine inactivity timeout
controls.description: Configures the computer-scoped Windows machine policy that locks the session after a specified period of inactivity.

parameters.label: Timeout
parameters.description: Seconds of inactivity before Windows locks the session.

controls.name: Diagnostic data level
controls.description: Configures the computer-scoped Windows machine policy that limits diagnostic data collection to a supported client level.

parameters.label: Diagnostic data level
parameters.description: Desired diagnostic-data collection level supported across the intended Windows client editions.

controls.name: Clipboard redirection
controls.description: Configures whether Remote Desktop sessions may redirect clipboard contents.

parameters.label: Allowed
parameters.description: Whether clipboard contents may be redirected in Remote Desktop sessions.

controls.name: Allow insecure SMB guest authentication
controls.description: Configures whether the SMB client allows insecure guest logons to SMB servers.

parameters.label: Enabled
parameters.description: Whether the SMB client allows insecure guest logons.

controls.name: Potentially unwanted application protection
controls.description: Configures the Microsoft Defender Antivirus mode for potentially unwanted application detection.

parameters.label: Mode
parameters.description: Desired mode for potentially unwanted application detection.

controls.name: Maximum scan CPU usage
controls.description: Configures the maximum average CPU percentage Microsoft Defender Antivirus may use during scheduled scans.

parameters.label: Maximum CPU
parameters.description: Maximum average CPU percentage Defender may use during scheduled scans. Set 0 to disable CPU throttling.

controls.name: Block read access to portable devices
controls.description: Configures the computer-scoped Windows machine policy for Windows Portable Devices read access according to the selected access state.

parameters.label: Access
parameters.description: Desired machine-policy state for Windows Portable Devices read access.

controls.name: Default inbound firewall action
controls.description: Configures the default inbound Windows Defender Firewall action for selected profiles.

parameters.label: Profiles
parameters.description: Firewall profiles to configure.

parameters.label: Action
parameters.description: Default inbound action for traffic that does not match a rule.

controls.name: Password history size
controls.description: Configures the local security policy that prevents reuse of a selected number of previous local account passwords.

parameters.label: Remembered passwords
parameters.description: Number of previous local account passwords that must not be reused.

controls.name: Sign-in legal notice caption
controls.description: Configures the computer-scoped Windows machine policy that sets the legal-notice title shown before interactive sign-in.

parameters.label: Caption
parameters.description: Title text shown in the legal-notice dialog before sign-in.

policy.groupPolicyName: Interactive logon: Message title for users attempting to log on

controls.name: Input personalization
controls.description: Configures the computer-scoped Windows machine policy that allows or blocks online speech recognition services.

parameters.label: Allowed
parameters.description: Whether users may enable online speech recognition services on the device.

policy.groupPolicyName: Allow users to enable online speech recognition services

controls.name: Drive redirection
controls.description: Configures whether Remote Desktop sessions may redirect client drives.

parameters.label: Allowed
parameters.description: Whether client drives may be redirected in Remote Desktop sessions.

controls.name: Require SMB server encryption
controls.description: Configures whether the SMB server component requires SMB encryption where supported.

parameters.label: Enabled
parameters.description: Whether the SMB server component requires SMB encryption.

controls.name: Automatic sample submission
controls.description: Configures how Microsoft Defender Antivirus submits file samples for deeper analysis.

parameters.label: Mode
parameters.description: Desired automatic sample submission mode.

controls.name: Scan removable drives
controls.description: Configures whether Microsoft Defender Antivirus scans removable drives during full scans.

parameters.label: Enabled
parameters.description: Whether Microsoft Defender Antivirus scans removable drives during full scans.

controls.name: Block write access to portable devices
controls.description: Configures the computer-scoped Windows machine policy for Windows Portable Devices write access according to the selected access state.

parameters.label: Access
parameters.description: Desired machine-policy state for Windows Portable Devices write access.

controls.name: Default outbound firewall action
controls.description: Configures the default outbound Windows Defender Firewall action for selected profiles.

parameters.label: Profiles
parameters.description: Firewall profiles to configure.

parameters.label: Action
parameters.description: Default outbound action for traffic that does not match a rule.

controls.name: Sign-in legal notice text
controls.description: Configures the computer-scoped Windows machine policy that sets the legal-notice message shown before interactive sign-in.

parameters.label: Notice text
parameters.description: Message text shown in the legal-notice dialog before sign-in.
parameters.defaultValue:
This system is for authorized use only.
Activity may be monitored and audited.

policy.groupPolicyName: Interactive logon: Message text for users attempting to log on

controls.name: Privacy settings experience
controls.description: Configures the computer-scoped Windows machine policy that allows or suppresses the privacy-settings experience on user logon.

parameters.label: Allowed
parameters.description: Whether Windows may launch the privacy-settings experience for new users or first sign-in after an upgrade.

policy.groupPolicyName: Don't launch privacy settings experience on user logon

controls.name: Printer redirection
controls.description: Configures whether Remote Desktop sessions may redirect client printers.

parameters.label: Allowed
parameters.description: Whether client printers may be redirected in Remote Desktop sessions.

controls.name: SMB1 server protocol
controls.description: Configures whether the SMB server component allows the SMB1 protocol.

parameters.label: Enabled
parameters.description: Whether the SMB server component allows SMB1.

controls.name: Cloud protection timeout
controls.description: Configures the extended Microsoft Defender Antivirus cloud-check timeout in seconds.

parameters.label: Extended timeout
parameters.description: Additional seconds that Defender may use for cloud checking, from 0 through 50.

controls.name: Log dropped packets
controls.description: Configures dropped-packet logging for selected Windows Defender Firewall profiles.

parameters.label: Profiles
parameters.description: Firewall profiles to configure.

parameters.label: Enabled
parameters.description: Whether dropped packets are logged for the selected firewall profiles.

controls.name: Always prompt for password
controls.description: Configures whether Remote Desktop always prompts for a password upon connection.

parameters.label: Enabled
parameters.description: Whether Remote Desktop always prompts for a password upon connection.

controls.name: Default workstation shares
controls.description: Configures whether the SMB server component publishes default administrative workstation shares.

parameters.label: Enabled
parameters.description: Whether the SMB server component publishes default administrative workstation shares.
